change); 7 clear the exact core too and are caught only by K'. Each label gives the three depths.

polygon core on the support: 24 of 60 columns meet K' (0 meet K(a) — the LP's own filter), carrying dual weight 3.4500 of 10.0000 against slack +5.33e-15; the A135 exact axis core alone removes 21 column(s) / weight 2.9500 — that part is inside the FROZEN certificate schema.
full pool: 2957 of 7673 generated columns meet K' (38.5%); K' vs container: worst excursion +0.00e+00 (0 = inside, no T5-type kill); K' vs K' between conditioned boxes: n/a (one conditioned square)

IN-VITRO LP with the column pool pruned by K' (one re-solve, 240 s cap, warm-started from this record): tau 8.840973 of budget 10 (eta -1.1590), converged False, 243.9 s — tau is below budget but the LP has NOT converged at the cap — a KILL CANDIDATE under the polygon core (A57's `dead_unconverged`), not a kill; a
warm continuation is what would settle it.

slot census (A113), MET (a column can meet several cells, so these do NOT partition the support): BL(0,1) doubly by 22 column(s) w 2.00; BL(0,0) doubly by 6 column(s) w 1.10; TR(0,1) doubly by 5 column(s) w 1.25*; TR(0,2) doubly by 9 column(s) w 2.00*; BR(1,0) doubly by 23 column(s) w 2.35; TL(0,1) doubly by 16

column(s) w 1.75; TL(0,0) singly by 1 column(s) w 1.00; TR(1,0) doubly by 6 column(s) w 1.50; TR(0,0) doubly by 4 column(s) w 1.25; BR(0,0) doubly by 15 column(s) w 1.90; BR(0,1) doubly by 8 column(s) w 1.75*; BR(0,2) doubly by 6 column(s) w 2.00* [36 named cells met; * = a conditioned square can reach it too]

slot census, BINNED (each column in exactly one bin — the nearest slot centre; these DO partition): BL(0,1) n=5 w=0.50; BL(0,0) n=4 w=1.00; TR(0,1) n=3 w=0.75(H); TR(0,2) n=4 w=0.75(H); BR(1,0) n=11 w=1.00; TL(0,1) n=4 w=0.50; TL(0,0) n=1 w=1.00; TR(1,0) n=3 w=1.00; TR(0,0) n=1 w=0.75; BR(0,0) n=1 w=0.25; BR(0,1)

BIN RULE: every dual-support column is assigned to EXACTLY ONE bin — the named slot cell whose CENTRE is nearest the column's centre (ties broken by name order), over BL/BR/TL/TR (i,j), i,j < 3. So the bin weights PARTITION the support's total dual weight; they do not double count. The separate 'met' counts below are the geometric

statement (a column can overlap several cells) and are A113's singly/doubly-met census, not a partition. The conditioned square is NOT a dual-support column — the node LP counts only the budget = 11 - #cores OTHER squares — so no bin contains it; a bin a conditioned box can itself reach is marked (H).
lane count (A118): BL(0,0) LANE>=2; BR(0,0) LANE>=2; TR(0,0) LANE>=2; TL(0,0) LANE>=2 [A118's stored record agrees]

CANDIDATE COVER — re-branch on the occupied slot (A113): A113's re-branching rule: the dual support keeps occupying BL(0,1) (4 column(s) snapped onto the cell, weight 0.40; 22 column(s) meet it, weight 2.00), so branch on it. Cover: (a) some square has its centre in the box of BL(0,1) -- add that box as a second
conditioned square and re-solve at budget-1; (b) no square occupies BL(0,1) -- add the NO-family for BL(0,1), which deletes exactly the columns the LP is leaning on.

what it needs to be a certified leaf: (a) the two children emitted and LP-certified at s0; (b) the NO-family arm needs the occupancy transfer of Lemma B-NO to stay sound on the window; (c) the conditioned-pair gate (cores pairwise disjoint) checked for the first child.

geometry check: 11 squares drawn in panel 2, worst containment excursion +3.26e-09, min pairwise SAT separation -1.39e-08; 0 support column(s) outside the container skipped in panel 1; 28 red-dashed column(s), every one re-verified by an independent SAT at 7³ poses.
